column1: # The verification lens: which station of a request each requirement of the
# checked-in standard applies to. One row per requirement id, TAB separated:
# Stations: admission, evidence, resolution, authority, scope, effect.
# "none" means the requirement is not a question about one request's path through
# the system - a documentation obligation, a dependency-currency rule or a
# deployment property - and no station is asked it.
# The classification is authored per SECTION of the standard and written out per
# id, because the id is what an answer cites and what a version bump moves. Every
# id in the checked-in export must appear here or the lens refuses to load, and
# the row count is checked against the declared count at build time.
# This table holds ids and classifications only. Requirement text lives in the
# ingested export and is never reproduced here - see NOTICE for the attribution
